// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

// Remix: Enable optimization (runs = 1), при желании — Enable viaIR

interface IERC20 {
    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);
}

interface ITokenReceiver {
    function onTokenReceived(address token, address creator, uint256 amount) external;
}

contract PolygonHybridAMM is ITokenReceiver {
    // ---------- Errors ----------
    error Reentrant();
    error OnlyAdmin();
    error TransferFailed();
    error TransferFromFailed();
    error FeeOnTransfer();
    error ZeroRouter();
    error OnlyTrustedRouter();
    error ZeroToken();
    error ZeroCreator();
    error AmountTooSmall();
    error PoolX1Exists();
    error PoolX2Exists();
    error StablecoinNotAllowed();
    error NoDecimals();
    error Not18Decimals();
    error AlreadyAllowed();
    error NotAllowed();
    error ZeroRef();
    error SelfRef();
    error AlreadyReferred();
    error NothingToClaim();
    error ZeroTo();
    error NoUsdcFee();
    error NoDaiFee();
    error UnsupportedToken();
    error TokenNotAllowed();
    error PoolX1Missing();
    error PoolX2Missing();
    error PoolX1MustExistFirst();
    error OnlyUsdcOrDai();
    error AmountZero();
    error NotEnoughX();
    error InsufficientLiquidity();
    error NoRealStable();
    error InvalidOutput();
    error SellExceedsAllocation();
    error NotEnoughDai();
    error InverseImpossible();
    error AmountTooSmallToSplit();
    error InsufficientTokenBalance();

    bool private _locked;
    modifier nonReentrant() {
        if (_locked) revert Reentrant();
        _locked = true;
        _;
        _locked = false;
    }
    modifier onlyAdmin() {
        if (msg.sender != admin) revert OnlyAdmin();
        _;
    }

    function _safeTransfer(IERC20 token, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool s, bytes memory d) = address(token).call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(token.transfer.selector, to, amount)
        );
        if (!(s && (d.length == 0 || abi.decode(d, (bool))))) revert TransferFailed();
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(IERC20 token, address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool s, bytes memory d) = address(token).call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(token.transferFrom.selector, from, to, amount)
        );
        if (!(s && (d.length == 0 || abi.decode(d, (bool))))) revert TransferFromFailed();
    }

    function _pullTokenXExact(address tokenX, address from, uint256 amount) internal {
        uint256 b = IERC20(tokenX).balanceOf(address(this));
        _safeTransferFrom(IERC20(tokenX), from, address(this), amount);
        if (IERC20(tokenX).balanceOf(address(this)) - b != amount) revert FeeOnTransfer();
    }

    IERC20 public constant USDC = IERC20(0x2791Bca1f2de4661ED88A30C99A7a9449Aa84174);
    IERC20 public constant DAI  = IERC20(0x8f3Cf7ad23Cd3CaDbD9735AFf958023239c6A063);

    uint256 public constant VIRTUAL_RESERVE = 10000 * 10**18;
    uint256 public constant TOTAL_FEE_BPS   = 100;
    uint256 public constant REF_SHARE_BPS   = 5000;
    uint256 public constant BPS_DENOMINATOR = 10000;

    address public immutable admin;
    address public trustedRouter;

    mapping(address => address) public tokenCreator;
    mapping(address => bool)    public allowedToken;
    mapping(address => address) public referrer;
    mapping(address => uint256) public refCount;
    mapping(address => uint256) public refBalanceUSDC18;
    mapping(address => uint256) public refBalanceDAI18;

    uint256 public projectFeeUSDC18;
    uint256 public projectFeeDAI18;

    mapping(address => mapping(address => mapping(uint8 => uint256))) public sellAllocation18;

    struct Pool {
        address tokenX;
        uint256 reserveX;
        uint256 virtualY;
        uint256 realUSDC18;
        uint256 realDAI18;
        bool exists;
    }
    struct BuyCalc { uint256 amountXOut; uint256 newReserveX; uint256 priceBefore; uint256 priceAfter; }
    struct SellCalc { uint256 stableOut18; uint256 newReserveX; uint256 priceBefore; uint256 priceAfter; }

    mapping(address => Pool) public poolX1;
    mapping(address => Pool) public poolX2;

    event TrustedRouterUpdated(address indexed router);
    event TokenReceivedFromRouter(address indexed token, address indexed creator, uint256 amount, uint256 toX1, uint256 toX2);
    event PoolCreated(address indexed tokenX, uint256 reserveX, uint256 virtualY, uint8 poolType);
    event SwapExecuted(address indexed user, address indexed tokenX, uint8 poolType, bool isBuy, uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOut, uint256 priceBefore, uint256 priceAfter);
    event ReservesUpdated(address indexed tokenX, uint8 poolType, uint256 reserveX, uint256 realUSDC18, uint256 realDAI18);
    event PriceUpdated(address indexed tokenX, uint8 poolType, uint256 price);
    event UserTrade(address indexed user, address indexed tokenX, uint8 poolType, bool isBuy, uint256 volumeUSD);
    event ReferralSet(address indexed user, address indexed referrer);
    event ReferralReward(address indexed referrer, address indexed user, address token, uint256 amount18);
    event ReferralClaimed(address indexed referrer, uint256 usdcPaid, uint256 daiPaid);
    event ProjectFeeAccrued(address token, uint256 amount18);
    event ProjectFeeWithdrawn(address token, address to, uint256 amount18);
    event TokenAllowed(address indexed token);
    event TokenDisallowed(address indexed token);
    event AllocationIncreased(address indexed user, address indexed tokenX, uint8 poolType, uint256 added18, uint256 total18);
    event AllocationUsed(address indexed user, address indexed tokenX, uint8 poolType, uint256 spent18, uint256 left18);

    modifier onlyPoolX1(address tokenX) { if (!poolX1[tokenX].exists) revert PoolX1Missing(); _; }
    modifier onlyPoolX2(address tokenX) { if (!poolX2[tokenX].exists) revert PoolX2Missing(); _; }

    constructor() { admin = msg.sender; }

    // ============================================================
    //  Router integration
    // ============================================================
    function setTrustedRouter(address _router) external onlyAdmin {
        if (_router == address(0)) revert ZeroRouter();
        trustedRouter = _router;
        emit TrustedRouterUpdated(_router);
    }

    function onTokenReceived(address token, address creator, uint256 amount)
        external override nonReentrant
    {
        if (msg.sender != trustedRouter) revert OnlyTrustedRouter();
        if (token == address(0)) revert ZeroToken();
        if (creator == address(0)) revert ZeroCreator();
        if (amount < 2) revert AmountTooSmall();
        if (poolX1[token].exists) revert PoolX1Exists();
        if (poolX2[token].exists) revert PoolX2Exists();

        if (!allowedToken[token]) {
            if (token == address(USDC) || token == address(DAI)) revert StablecoinNotAllowed();
            (bool ok, bytes memory d) = token.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSignature("decimals()"));
            if (!ok || d.length < 32) revert NoDecimals();
            if (abi.decode(d, (uint256)) != 18) revert Not18Decimals();
            allowedToken[token] = true;
            emit TokenAllowed(token);
        }

        tokenCreator[token] = creator;

        if (IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this)) < amount) revert InsufficientTokenBalance();

        uint256 halfX1 = amount / 2;
        uint256 halfX2 = amount - halfX1;
        if (halfX1 == 0) revert AmountTooSmallToSplit();

        poolX1[token] = Pool(token, halfX1, VIRTUAL_RESERVE, 0, 0, true);
        emit PoolCreated(token, halfX1, VIRTUAL_RESERVE, 1);

        uint256 priceX1 = _getPrice(poolX1[token]);
        uint256 virtualY2 = priceX1 * halfX2;
        poolX2[token] = Pool(token, halfX2, virtualY2, 0, 0, true);
        emit PoolCreated(token, halfX2, virtualY2, 2);

        _emitPool(token, true);
        _emitPool(token, false);
        emit TokenReceivedFromRouter(token, creator, amount, halfX1, halfX2);
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  Whitelist
    // ============================================================
    function allowToken(address token) external onlyAdmin {
        if (token == address(0)) revert ZeroToken();
        if (token == address(USDC) || token == address(DAI)) revert StablecoinNotAllowed();
        if (allowedToken[token]) revert AlreadyAllowed();
        (bool ok, bytes memory d) = token.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSignature("decimals()"));
        if (!ok || d.length < 32) revert NoDecimals();
        if (abi.decode(d, (uint256)) != 18) revert Not18Decimals();
        allowedToken[token] = true;
        emit TokenAllowed(token);
    }

    function disallowToken(address token) external onlyAdmin {
        if (!allowedToken[token]) revert NotAllowed();
        allowedToken[token] = false;
        emit TokenDisallowed(token);
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  Referrals
    // ============================================================
    function setReferrer(address _ref) external {
        if (_ref == address(0)) revert ZeroRef();
        if (_ref == msg.sender) revert SelfRef();
        if (referrer[msg.sender] != address(0)) revert AlreadyReferred();
        referrer[msg.sender] = _ref;
        refCount[_ref] += 1;
        emit ReferralSet(msg.sender, _ref);
    }

    function claimReferralRewards() external nonReentrant {
        uint256 u = refBalanceUSDC18[msg.sender];
        uint256 d = refBalanceDAI18[msg.sender];
        if (u == 0 && d == 0) revert NothingToClaim();
        refBalanceUSDC18[msg.sender] = 0;
        refBalanceDAI18[msg.sender] = 0;

        uint256 up = 0;
        uint256 dp = 0;
        if (u > 0) { up = u / 10**12; if (up > 0) _safeTransfer(USDC, msg.sender, up); }
        if (d > 0) { dp = d; _safeTransfer(DAI, msg.sender, dp); }
        emit ReferralClaimed(msg.sender, up, dp);
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  Project fee
    // ============================================================
    function withdrawProjectFee(address token, address to) external nonReentrant onlyAdmin {
        if (to == address(0)) revert ZeroTo();
        if (token == address(USDC)) {
            uint256 a = projectFeeUSDC18;
            if (a == 0) revert NoUsdcFee();
            projectFeeUSDC18 = 0;
            _safeTransfer(USDC, to, a / 10**12);
            emit ProjectFeeWithdrawn(token, to, a);
        } else if (token == address(DAI)) {
            uint256 a = projectFeeDAI18;
            if (a == 0) revert NoDaiFee();
            projectFeeDAI18 = 0;
            _safeTransfer(DAI, to, a);
            emit ProjectFeeWithdrawn(token, to, a);
        } else { revert UnsupportedToken(); }
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  Helpers
    // ============================================================
    function _getPrice(Pool storage p) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (p.reserveX == 0) return 0;
        return (p.virtualY + p.realUSDC18 + p.realDAI18) / p.reserveX;
    }

    function _setTargetPrice(address tokenX, bool targetIsX1, uint256 desiredPrice) internal {
        Pool storage t = targetIsX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        uint256 realY = t.realUSDC18 + t.realDAI18;
        uint256 newVirtualY = desiredPrice * t.reserveX;
        if (newVirtualY < realY) revert InverseImpossible();
        t.virtualY = newVirtualY - realY;
    }

    function _emitPool(address tokenX, bool isX1) internal {
        Pool storage p = isX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        uint8 poolType = isX1 ? 1 : 2;
        emit ReservesUpdated(tokenX, poolType, p.reserveX, p.realUSDC18, p.realDAI18);
        if (p.reserveX > 0) {
            uint256 price = (p.virtualY + p.realUSDC18 + p.realDAI18) / p.reserveX;
            emit PriceUpdated(tokenX, poolType, price);
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  Manual pool creation
    // ============================================================
    function createPoolX1(address tokenX, uint256 amountX) external nonReentrant {
        if (!allowedToken[tokenX]) revert TokenNotAllowed();
        if (poolX1[tokenX].exists) revert PoolX1Exists();
        if (amountX == 0) revert AmountZero();
        _pullTokenXExact(tokenX, msg.sender, amountX);
        poolX1[tokenX] = Pool(tokenX, amountX, VIRTUAL_RESERVE, 0, 0, true);
        emit PoolCreated(tokenX, amountX, VIRTUAL_RESERVE, 1);
        _emitPool(tokenX, true);
    }

    function createPoolX2(address tokenX, uint256 amountX) external nonReentrant {
        if (!allowedToken[tokenX]) revert TokenNotAllowed();
        if (!poolX1[tokenX].exists) revert PoolX1MustExistFirst();
        if (poolX2[tokenX].exists) revert PoolX2Exists();
        if (amountX == 0) revert AmountZero();
        _pullTokenXExact(tokenX, msg.sender, amountX);

        uint256 priceX1 = _getPrice(poolX1[tokenX]);
        uint256 virtualY2 = priceX1 * amountX;
        poolX2[tokenX] = Pool(tokenX, amountX, virtualY2, 0, 0, true);
        emit PoolCreated(tokenX, amountX, virtualY2, 2);
        _emitPool(tokenX, false);
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  Trading
    // ============================================================
    function buyX1(address tokenX, address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn)
        external nonReentrant onlyPoolX1(tokenX)
    {
        if (!poolX2[tokenX].exists) revert PoolX2Missing();
        _buy(tokenX, tokenIn, amountIn, true);
    }
    function buyX2(address tokenX, address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn)
        external nonReentrant onlyPoolX2(tokenX)
    {
        if (!poolX1[tokenX].exists) revert PoolX1Missing();
        _buy(tokenX, tokenIn, amountIn, false);
    }
    function sellX1(address tokenX, uint256 amountX)
        external nonReentrant onlyPoolX1(tokenX)
    {
        if (!poolX2[tokenX].exists) revert PoolX2Missing();
        _sell(tokenX, amountX, true);
    }
    function sellX2(address tokenX, uint256 amountX)
        external nonReentrant onlyPoolX2(tokenX)
    {
        if (!poolX1[tokenX].exists) revert PoolX1Missing();
        _sell(tokenX, amountX, false);
    }

    function _buy(address tokenX, address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn, bool usePoolX1) internal {
        if (tokenIn != address(USDC) && tokenIn != address(DAI)) revert OnlyUsdcOrDai();
        if (amountIn == 0) revert AmountZero();

        uint8 poolType = usePoolX1 ? 1 : 2;
        Pool storage pool = usePoolX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        Pool storage target = usePoolX1 ? poolX2[tokenX] : poolX1[tokenX];

        uint256 ppBefore = _getPrice(pool) * _getPrice(target);

        // --- fees + net input in 18 decimals ---
        uint256 amountForPool18;
        {
            uint256 totalFee = (amountIn * TOTAL_FEE_BPS) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;
            uint256 refFeeIn = (totalFee * REF_SHARE_BPS) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;
            _accrueTradeFees(tokenIn, refFeeIn, totalFee - refFeeIn);
            uint256 net = amountIn - totalFee;
            amountForPool18 = tokenIn == address(USDC) ? net * 10**12 : net;
        }

        BuyCalc memory calc = _calculateBuy(pool, amountForPool18);

        pool.reserveX = calc.newReserveX;
        if (tokenIn == address(USDC)) pool.realUSDC18 += amountForPool18;
        else                       pool.realDAI18  += amountForPool18;

        _safeTransferFrom(IERC20(tokenIn), msg.sender, address(this), amountIn);
        _safeTransfer(IERC20(tokenX), msg.sender, calc.amountXOut);

        uint256 newAlloc = sellAllocation18[msg.sender][tokenX][poolType] + amountForPool18;
        sellAllocation18[msg.sender][tokenX][poolType] = newAlloc;
        emit AllocationIncreased(msg.sender, tokenX, poolType, amountForPool18, newAlloc);

        emit SwapExecuted(msg.sender, tokenX, poolType, true, amountIn, calc.amountXOut, calc.priceBefore, calc.priceAfter);
        emit UserTrade(msg.sender, tokenX, poolType, true, amountForPool18);

        // --- inverse price sync ---
        if (ppBefore > 0) {
            uint256 srcAfter = _getPrice(pool);
            if (srcAfter > 0) _setTargetPrice(tokenX, !usePoolX1, ppBefore / srcAfter);
        }
        _emitPool(tokenX, usePoolX1);
        _emitPool(tokenX, !usePoolX1);
    }

    function _calculateBuy(Pool storage pool, uint256 amountForPool18)
        internal view returns (BuyCalc memory c)
    {
        uint256 reserveX = pool.reserveX;
        uint256 oldEffectiveY = pool.virtualY + pool.realUSDC18 + pool.realDAI18;
        c.priceBefore = reserveX > 0 ? oldEffectiveY / reserveX : 0;

        uint256 k = reserveX * oldEffectiveY;
        uint256 newY = oldEffectiveY + amountForPool18;
        c.newReserveX = k / newY;
        c.amountXOut = reserveX - c.newReserveX;
        if (c.amountXOut == 0 || c.amountXOut >= reserveX) revert InsufficientLiquidity();

        c.priceAfter = c.newReserveX > 0 ? newY / c.newReserveX : 0;
    }

    function _sell(address tokenX, uint256 amountX, bool usePoolX1) internal {
        if (amountX == 0) revert AmountZero();

        uint8 poolType = usePoolX1 ? 1 : 2;
        Pool storage pool = usePoolX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        Pool storage target = usePoolX1 ? poolX2[tokenX] : poolX1[tokenX];
        if (amountX >= pool.reserveX) revert NotEnoughX();

        uint256 ppBefore = _getPrice(pool) * _getPrice(target);

        SellCalc memory calc = _calculateSell(pool, amountX);

        uint256 alloc = sellAllocation18[msg.sender][tokenX][poolType];
        if (alloc < calc.stableOut18) revert SellExceedsAllocation();

        // --- fees ---
        uint256 userOut18;
        {
            uint256 totalFee = (calc.stableOut18 * TOTAL_FEE_BPS) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;
            uint256 refFee18 = (totalFee * REF_SHARE_BPS) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;
            userOut18 = calc.stableOut18 - totalFee;
            _deductAndAccrueSellFees(pool, refFee18, totalFee - refFee18);
        }

        _pullTokenXExact(tokenX, msg.sender, amountX);
        pool.reserveX = calc.newReserveX;
        _payoutStable(pool, msg.sender, userOut18);

        uint256 newAlloc = alloc - calc.stableOut18;
        sellAllocation18[msg.sender][tokenX][poolType] = newAlloc;
        emit AllocationUsed(msg.sender, tokenX, poolType, calc.stableOut18, newAlloc);

        emit SwapExecuted(msg.sender, tokenX, poolType, false, amountX, userOut18, calc.priceBefore, calc.priceAfter);
        emit UserTrade(msg.sender, tokenX, poolType, false, userOut18);

        if (ppBefore > 0) {
            uint256 srcAfter = _getPrice(pool);
            if (srcAfter > 0) _setTargetPrice(tokenX, !usePoolX1, ppBefore / srcAfter);
        }
        _emitPool(tokenX, usePoolX1);
        _emitPool(tokenX, !usePoolX1);
    }

    function _calculateSell(Pool storage pool, uint256 amountX)
        internal view returns (SellCalc memory c)
    {
        uint256 oldRealY = pool.realUSDC18 + pool.realDAI18;
        uint256 effectiveY = pool.virtualY + oldRealY;
        uint256 reserveX = pool.reserveX;

        c.priceBefore = reserveX > 0 ? effectiveY / reserveX : 0;

        uint256 k = reserveX * effectiveY;
        c.newReserveX = reserveX + amountX;
        uint256 newEffectiveY = k / c.newReserveX;
        if (newEffectiveY <= pool.virtualY) revert NoRealStable();

        uint256 newRealY = newEffectiveY - pool.virtualY;
        c.stableOut18 = oldRealY - newRealY;
        if (c.stableOut18 == 0 || c.stableOut18 > oldRealY) revert InvalidOutput();

        c.priceAfter = c.newReserveX > 0 ? newEffectiveY / c.newReserveX : 0;
    }

    function _payoutStable(Pool storage pool, address user, uint256 stableOut18) internal {
        uint256 u = pool.realUSDC18;
        if (stableOut18 <= u) {
            pool.realUSDC18 = u - stableOut18;
            _safeTransfer(USDC, user, stableOut18 / 10**12);
        } else {
            pool.realUSDC18 = 0;
            _safeTransfer(USDC, user, u / 10**12);
            uint256 rem = stableOut18 - u;
            if (pool.realDAI18 < rem) revert NotEnoughDai();
            pool.realDAI18 -= rem;
            _safeTransfer(DAI, user, rem);
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  Fee accrual
    // ============================================================
    function _accrueTradeFees(address tokenIn, uint256 refFeeIn, uint256 projFeeIn) internal {
        bool isUsdc = tokenIn == address(USDC);
        uint256 mult = isUsdc ? 10**12 : 1;
        address ref = referrer[msg.sender];

        if (projFeeIn > 0) {
            uint256 a = projFeeIn * mult;
            if (isUsdc) projectFeeUSDC18 += a; else projectFeeDAI18 += a;
            emit ProjectFeeAccrued(tokenIn, a);
        }
        if (refFeeIn > 0) {
            uint256 a = refFeeIn * mult;
            if (ref != address(0)) {
                if (isUsdc) refBalanceUSDC18[ref] += a; else refBalanceDAI18[ref] += a;
                emit ReferralReward(ref, msg.sender, tokenIn, a);
            } else {
                if (isUsdc) projectFeeUSDC18 += a; else projectFeeDAI18 += a;
                emit ProjectFeeAccrued(tokenIn, a);
            }
        }
    }

    function _deductAndAccrueSellFees(Pool storage pool, uint256 refFee18, uint256 projFee18) internal {
        if (projFee18 > 0) {
            (uint256 u, uint256 d) = _deductStableFromPool(pool, projFee18);
            if (u > 0) { projectFeeUSDC18 += u; emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(USDC), u); }
            if (d > 0) { projectFeeDAI18  += d; emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(DAI), d); }
        }
        if (refFee18 == 0) return;

        (uint256 ru, uint256 rd) = _deductStableFromPool(pool, refFee18);
        address ref = referrer[msg.sender];
        if (ref != address(0)) {
            if (ru > 0) { refBalanceUSDC18[ref] += ru; emit ReferralReward(ref, msg.sender, address(USDC), ru); }
            if (rd > 0) { refBalanceDAI18[ref]  += rd; emit ReferralReward(ref, msg.sender, address(DAI), rd); }
        } else {
            if (ru > 0) { projectFeeUSDC18 += ru; emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(USDC), ru); }
            if (rd > 0) { projectFeeDAI18  += rd; emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(DAI), rd); }
        }
    }

    function _deductStableFromPool(Pool storage pool, uint256 amount18)
        internal returns (uint256 usdcPart, uint256 daiPart)
    {
        uint256 u = pool.realUSDC18;
        if (amount18 <= u) {
            pool.realUSDC18 = u - amount18;
            return (amount18, 0);
        } else {
            pool.realUSDC18 = 0;
            uint256 rem = amount18 - u;
            if (pool.realDAI18 < rem) revert NotEnoughDai();
            pool.realDAI18 -= rem;
            return (u, rem);
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  Single view function
    // ============================================================
    function getPoolState(address tokenX, bool isX1) external view returns (
        uint256 reserveX,
        uint256 virtualY,
        uint256 usdc,
        uint256 dai,
        uint256 price,
        uint256 liquidity
    ) {
        Pool storage p = isX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        if (!p.exists) revert PoolX1Missing();
        reserveX = p.reserveX;
        virtualY = p.virtualY;
        usdc = p.realUSDC18 / 10**12;
        dai  = p.realDAI18;
        liquidity = p.virtualY + p.realUSDC18 + p.realDAI18;
        price = reserveX > 0 ? liquidity / reserveX : 0;
    }
}
